Anna believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Jack advised Anna to try singing as a new hobby. Little by little, things began to change. In fact, tomorrow will reach thirty-five degrees Celsius.

There are always more possibilities than we expect. The experience taught Anna more than any book could. At first, Anna found it difficult to keep the habit. What's more, the noodles come with fresh shrimp.

The flower market has become an important part of daily life. Anna keeps a small bird at home and feeds it every morning. Jack always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Also, the field trip visits the tide pools.

Anna wrote down every idea in a small notebook. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. The camping site looked quieter than usual that evening. Companion planting pairs carrots with onions.
Anna thanked Jack for the honest advice. People around Anna often share different ideas about the camping site. Anna has practiced baseball for three years and won a prize last term.
